annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence in Policing: AI technologies currently used to improve the efficiency and service delivery of police's corporate or enabling functions
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence in Policing: AI technologies currently used to improve the efficiency and service delivery of police's corporate or enabling functions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Evidence Based Policing Centre, New Zealand Police
annotation.summary_en: New Zealand Police research report (July 2024) reviewing AI tools used in policing's corporate and enabling functions, such as documentation, audio/video analysis, data integration, biometrics, call management and recruitment. It identifies performance, integration, privacy and trust challenges and recommends keeping a human in the loop and strengthening governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Explain and communicate causes of AI performance inaccuracies such as bias and poor data.
Keep a human in the loop with training and continuous oversight.
Ensure effective integration, governance and data architecture.
Address employee trust, deskilling and job-loss fears through open communication.
AI tools cover documentation, audio/video analysis, data integration, biometrics, call management, community interaction and recruiting.
